The Fifth Committee met from May 4th until today, holding 6 plenary meetings and numerous informal consultations. The report of the Fifth Committee containing recommendations for consideration during the second part of the Resumed '80s session of the General Assembly is reflected in A/C5/80/INF/5. At the outset, I wish to highlight as its key achievement the draft resolution on the much-needed credit return methodology to deal with the liquidity challenges faced by the organization. Other recommendations include draft resolutions on the following: financial reports and audited financial statements and reports of the Board of auditors, triennial review of the rates and standards for reimbursement to member states for contingent-owned equipment, rates of reimbursement to troop and police-contributing countries, support account for peacekeeping operations, financing of the regional service center in Entebbe, Uganda, and the United Nations Logistics Base at Brindisi.
